A bug fix for 0.3.2 users. 0.3.x gets security and critical fixes only; 1.0 is published as `@honeybbq/teamspeak`. See the [migration guide](https://github.com/HoneyBBQ/teamspeak-js/blob/main/docs/migrating-to-1.0.md).

## Fixes

- Encrypted voice from the server keeps decrypting for the whole session. Voice, whisper, ping and pong each wrap their own 16-bit packet id, and the generation that counts the wraps is part of the packet key; the client used generation 0 for them, so from the second wrap on, about 45 minutes of incoming voice at 50 packets a second, `voiceData` stopped while the connection stayed up. Channels whose voice is not encrypted were not affected. Thanks to @ZoftTy, who found and diagnosed this.
